summary.summary: Holiday week thin volume with a massive geopolitical catalyst: China launched 'Justice Mission 2025' live-fire drills around Taiwan on Dec 29, deploying 130 warplanes and 22 ships — the second-largest military provocation ever. This was triggered by the US $11.1B arms sale to Taiwan (Dec 18) and Japan's PM stating military readiness to intervene. S&P 500 at 6,930 near all-time highs, VIX in 13.5-15 range but with spiky behavior. FOMC minutes due Dec 30. Santa Claus rally period active. Silver hit all-time highs above $79. Oil weak near $58 WTI. Thin liquidity amplifies moves in both directions.

scenarios.trade: Silver is the single strongest momentum trade in markets right now. The Taiwan crisis adds a fresh geopolitical bid on top of existing structural drivers (industrial AI demand, rate cuts, supply deficit). The Dec 29 session opened with silver briefly above $80 before profit-taking pulled it back. Thin holiday volume means sharp moves. Entry on any pullback toward $72-73 with target at the session highs.

scenarios.implication: Profit-taking after 113% YTD gain. Dollar strength on hawkish FOMC minutes (Dec 30). Margin calls in thin liquidity could force liquidation. If Taiwan tensions de-escalate quickly, safe-haven premium evaporates.

scenarios.trade: The Taiwan arms sale is a multi-year revenue pipeline for Lockheed (HIMARS, ATACMS, Javelin missiles all Lockheed platforms). China's military response validates the threat narrative and makes additional procurement more likely. Defense is the clearest beneficiary of the geopolitical escalation cycle. Stock may have dipped Friday on China sanctions headline — buy the dip.

scenarios.implication: China sanctions on 20 US defense firms could create headline risk. Thin holiday volume limits institutional participation. Stock already up 36% in 2025 — limited upside in a day trade. Government shutdown fiscal uncertainty could delay procurement timelines.

scenarios.trade: RTX is the best-positioned defense prime for the Taiwan cycle. Record backlog provides visibility. Stock at all-time highs near $185 shows momentum. The Taiwan drills will dominate Monday morning news coverage and drive defense sector flows. RTX's missile/radar business is directly relevant to Taiwan's defense needs.

scenarios.implication: At all-time highs — limited room for error. Thin holiday volume means institutional flows are muted. China sanctions headline risk. If drills end quickly without escalation, the bid fades.

scenarios.trade: Micron is the purest US-listed play on the memory chip shortage. The Dec 18 earnings catalyst is still being digested — post-earnings drift is likely. Taiwan drills actually help the bull case: any TSMC/Taiwan supply disruption fear tightens memory supply further and benefits Micron's pricing power. Structural multi-quarter trade.

scenarios.implication: Stock already surged 16% on Dec 18 — may be extended near-term. Taiwan drills could hurt broader tech sentiment. Thin holiday volume. If memory shortage fears ease on new supply announcements, the premium compresses.

scenarios.trade: The Dec 29 infrastructure cyber attacks are a fresh catalyst that will drive headlines Monday. CrowdStrike is the #1 name investors buy when cyber threats escalate. The stock is in a corrective phase (-6.6% in Dec) trading near 474, below its 50-day MA — this gives a better entry than chasing at highs. Geopolitical tensions (Taiwan, Iran) increase state-sponsored cyber activity.

scenarios.implication: Down 6.6% in December for a reason — could be institutional rotation out of cybersecurity into defense. Thin holiday volume limits the bounce. Valuation premium is extreme. If attacks are contained quickly, urgency fades.

scenarios.trade: Tesla is trading on narrative (AI, robotaxi, energy) while the core auto business deteriorates. Q4 deliveries likely missed due to Q3 pull-forward from subsidy expiration. BYD overtaking Tesla in BEVs is a structural shift. The stock fell among Big Tech decliners on Dec 26. Holiday week profit-taking after a massive H2 rally. Delivery numbers due Jan 2 — positioning begins now.

scenarios.implication: Tesla has defied fundamentals for years — narrative can override metrics. Any positive robotaxi/AI headline could squeeze shorts. Elon Musk political influence provides policy tailwinds. Stock could rally into year-end on Santa Claus effect despite fundamentals.

scenarios.trade: If silver holds above $75+ and pushes toward $80, silver miners like PAAS get amplified upside through operating leverage. The Taiwan crisis adds incremental safe-haven demand. PAAS is the most liquid pure-play silver miner. Holiday thin volume can amplify moves. The risk-reward is compelling with tight stop below recent support.

scenarios.implication: Miners have operational risks (costs, labor, jurisdiction) that the metal ETF doesn't. PAAS already up massively YTD — could be extended. Silver profit-taking is the biggest risk. Company-specific execution risk.
